notes: Panel Settings is tighter and opens smaller when a panel brings its own look. Rows are the height of the control in them rather than a fixed 38 pixels, the label column and the side rail are narrower, and the content sits in one spacing…

The window now opens at 560 by 520 for a themed panel instead of 780 by 640, and can be dragged considerably smaller. A size you have already set for yourself is kept - the new numbers only affect a window you have not sized.
The window also opens in the panel’s own background colour, so there is no flash of the Control Panel grey before the styling arrives.
